027public class RuinsFleetRouteManager extends BaseRouteFleetManager {
028
029        protected StarSystemAPI system;
030        
031        public RuinsFleetRouteManager(StarSystemAPI system) {
032                super(1f, 14f);
033                this.system = system;
034        }
035
036        protected String getRouteSourceId() {
037                return "salvage_" + system.getId();
038        }
039        
040        protected int getMaxFleets() {
041                //if (true) return 0;
042                
043                float salvage = getVeryApproximateSalvageValue(system);
044                return (int) (1 + Math.min(salvage / 2, 7));
045        }
046        
047        protected void addRouteFleetIfPossible() {
048                if (TutorialMissionIntel.isTutorialInProgress()) {
049                        return;
050                }
051                
052                MarketAPI market = pickSourceMarket();
053                if (market == null) return;
054                
055                Long seed = new Random().nextLong();
056                String id = getRouteSourceId();
057                
058                OptionalFleetData extra = new OptionalFleetData(market);
059                
060                RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().addRoute(id, market, seed, extra, this);
061                
062                float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(market.getLocationInHyperspace(), system.getLocation());
063                float travelDays = distLY * 1.5f;
064                
065                float prepDays = 2f + (float) Math.random() * 3f;
066                float endDays = 8f + (float) Math.random() * 3f; // longer since includes time from jump-point to source
067
068                float totalTravelTime = prepDays + endDays + travelDays * 2f;
069                float stayDays = Math.max(20f, totalTravelTime);
070                
071                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(prepDays, market.getPrimaryEntity()));
072                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(travelDays, market.getPrimaryEntity(), system.getCenter()));
073                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(stayDays, system.getCenter()));
074                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(travelDays, system.getCenter(), market.getPrimaryEntity()));
075                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(endDays, market.getPrimaryEntity()));
076        }
077        
078        
079        public static float getVeryApproximateSalvageValue(StarSystemAPI system) {
080                return system.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.SALVAGEABLE).size();
081        }
082        
083        public MarketAPI pickSourceMarket() {
084//              if (true) {
085//                      return Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("jangala");
086//              }
087                
088                WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> markets = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>();
089                
090                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
091                        if (market.getFaction().isHostileTo(Factions.INDEPENDENT)) continue;
092                        if (market.getContainingLocation() == null) continue;
093                        if (market.getContainingLocation().isHyperspace()) continue;
094                        if (market.isHidden()) continue;
095                        
096                        float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(system.getLocation(), market.getLocationInHyperspace());
097                        float weight = market.getSize();
098                        
099                        float f = Math.max(0.1f, 1f - Math.min(1f, distLY / 20f));
100                        f *= f;
101                        weight *= f;
102                        
103                        markets.add(market, weight);
104                }
105                
106                return markets.pick();
107        }
108        
109
110        public CampaignFleetAPI spawnFleet(RouteData route) {
111                Random random = route.getRandom();
112                
113                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
114                picker.add(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_SMALL, 10f);
115                picker.add(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_MEDIUM, 15f);
116                picker.add(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_LARGE, 5f);
117                
118                String type = picker.pick();
119                
120                boolean pirate = random.nextBoolean();
121                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = createScavenger(type, system.getLocation(), route, route.getMarket(), pirate, random);
122                if (fleet == null) return null;;
123                
124                fleet.addScript(new ScavengerFleetAssignmentAI(fleet, route, pirate));
125                
126                return fleet;
127        }
128        
129        public static CampaignFleetAPI createScavenger(String type, Vector2f locInHyper, MarketAPI source, boolean pirate, Random random) {
130                return createScavenger(type, locInHyper, null, source, pirate, random);
131        }
132        public static CampaignFleetAPI createScavenger(String type, Vector2f locInHyper, RouteData route, MarketAPI source, boolean pirate, Random random) {
133                if (random == null) random = new Random();
134
135                
136                if (type == null) {
137                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
138                        picker.add(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_SMALL, 10f);
139                        picker.add(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_MEDIUM, 15f);
140                        picker.add(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_LARGE, 5f);
141                        type = picker.pick();
142                }
143                
144                
145                int combat = 0;
146                int freighter = 0;
147                int tanker = 0;
148                int transport = 0;
149                int utility = 0;
150                
151                
152                if (type.equals(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_SMALL)) {
153                        combat = random.nextInt(2) + 1;
154                        tanker = random.nextInt(2) + 1;
155                        utility = random.nextInt(2) + 1;
156                } else if (type.equals(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_MEDIUM)) {
157                        combat = 4 + random.nextInt(5);
158                        freighter = 4 + random.nextInt(5);
159                        tanker = 3 + random.nextInt(4);
160                        transport = random.nextInt(2);
161                        utility = 2 + random.nextInt(3);
162                } else if (type.equals(FleetTypes.SCAVENGER_LARGE)) {
163                        combat = 7 + random.nextInt(8);
164                        freighter = 6 + random.nextInt(7);
165                        tanker = 5 + random.nextInt(6);
166                        transport = 3 + random.nextInt(8);
167                        utility = 4 + random.nextInt(5);
168                }
169                
170                if (pirate) {
171//                      combat += transport;
172//                      combat += utility;
173                        transport = utility = 0;
174                }
175                
176                combat *= 5f;
177                freighter *= 3f;
178                tanker *= 3f;
179                transport *= 1.5f;
180                
181                FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3(
182                                route != null ? route.getMarket() : source, 
183                                locInHyper,
184                                Factions.SCAVENGERS, // quality will always be reduced by non-market-faction penalty, which is what we want 
185                                route == null ? null : route.getQualityOverride(),
186                                type,
187                                combat, // combatPts
188                                freighter, // freighterPts 
189                                tanker, // tankerPts
190                                transport, // transportPts
191                                0f, // linerPts
192                                utility, // utilityPts
193                                0f // qualityMod
194                                );
195                if (route != null) {
196                        params.timestamp = route.getTimestamp();
197                }
198                params.random = random;
199                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(params);
200                
201                if (fleet == null || fleet.isEmpty()) return null;
202                
203                fleet.setFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT, true);
204                
205                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SCAVENGER, true);
206                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FLEET_BUYS_STUFF, true);
207                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FLEET_BUYS_STUFF_RATE, SellToFleet.SCAVENGER_SELL_VALUE_MULT);
208                
209                if (pirate || true) {
210                        Misc.makeLowRepImpact(fleet, "scav");
211                }
212                
213                return fleet;
214        }
215

217                return false;
218        }
219
220        public boolean shouldRepeat(RouteData route) {
221                return false;
222        }

224        public void reportAboutToBeDespawnedByRouteManager(RouteData route) {
225                
226        }
227}
